cards.headline: Ultra-widefield color fundus photography in diabetic retinopathy

source.title: Ultra-widefield color fundus photography in diabetic retinopathy: from panretinal assessment to multimodal integration.
source.excerpt: Combined with artificial intelligence and multimodal data integration, UWF-CFP has the potential to contribute to a future care model that integrates ocular and systemic risk assessment, which we tentatively term "eye-system collaborative management," though this paradigm remains to be validated in prospective studies.

cards.headline: The Rise of Agentic AI and Self-Driving Laboratories

source.title: The Rise of Agentic AI and Self-Driving Laboratories: Reshaping Drug Discovery, Development, and Precision Medicine.
source.excerpt: Accordingly, fully autonomous pharmaceutical research should be regarded as a long-term research objective rather than an established technological capability, with its realization dependent on further advances in scientific reasoning, experimental validation, regulatory governance, cybersecurity, and human-AI collaboration.

source.title: Ernie Irvan
source.excerpt: Virgil Earnest Irvan ist ein ehemaliger US-amerikanischer Automobilrennfahrer, der bei NASCAR-Rennen aktiv war. Er ging im NASCAR Winston Cup in über 300 Rennen an den Start und gehörte in den 1990er Jahren zu den Titelfavoriten.

cards.headline: The effectiveness of Kanggan granules in treating hand, foot and mouth disease in children

source.title: The effectiveness of Kanggan granules in treating hand, foot and mouth disease in children: a meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: Kanggan granules may provide potential clinical benefits for children with HFMD as an adjunctive therapy. However, the certainty of evidence remains limited due to methodological weaknesses, substantial heterogeneity, possible publication bias, and insufficient safety reporting.

cards.headline: Long-term safety and clinical effects of probiotic supplementation in at-risk populations

source.title: Long-term safety and clinical effects of probiotic supplementation in at-risk populations: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: The pooled estimate was compatible with a possible clinical benefit but did not reach conventional statistical significance. The available evidence does not permit conclusions about long-term safety because adverse-event reporting was inconsistent, follow-up was limited, and rare or strain-specific harms could not be assessed. Larger, prospectively registered trials are required.

source.title: Led Zeppelin IV
source.excerpt: Led Zeppelin IV ist das vierte Studioalbum der britischen Rockband Led Zeppelin aus dem Jahr 1971. Das Album wird oft einfach als Led Zeppelin IV bezeichnet, hat offiziell jedoch keinen Namen. Wegen der vier Symbole auf der Innenseite des Plattencovers wird es gelegentlich auch Four Symbols, Untitled oder ZoSo.

cards.headline: Artificial Intelligence and Digital Impressions: The Positives and the Pitfalls

source.title: Artificial Intelligence and Digital Impressions: The Positives and the Pitfalls.
source.excerpt: By distinguishing between beneficial data filtering and potentially misleading data inference, the aim is to support clinicians in making informed decisions and maintaining appropriate scrutiny of AI-assisted digital impressions.

cards.headline: Exercise modalities in mild cognitive impairment

source.title: Exercise modalities in mild cognitive impairment: a systematic review and network meta-analysis of comparative effectiveness.
source.excerpt: Different exercise modalities exhibit domain-specific cognitive benefits in individuals with MCI. Multicomponent exercise appears most effective for improving global cognitive function, mind-body exercise may preferentially benefit memory-related outcomes, and resistance exercise may provide greater benefits for executive-function-related outcomes.

source.title: Eisenbahnunfall von Walpertskirchen
source.excerpt: Bei dem Eisenbahnunfall von Walpertskirchen fuhr am frühen Morgen des 8. November 1951 ein Personenzug frontal auf einen Nahgüterzug auf. 16 Menschen starben, 41 weitere wurden verletzt.

cards.headline: Prevalence and impact of orofacial pain in older adults with dementia

source.title: Prevalence and impact of orofacial pain in older adults with dementia: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: Approximately one in five older adults with dementia experiences orofacial pain, which significantly affects quality of life. However, underdiagnosis remains common due to cognitive and communicative limitations.

source.title: AI-Augmented Multi-Omics for Abiotic Stress Responses: A New Frontier in Plant Hormone Systems Biology.

cards.headline: Benefit-risk profiling of advanced therapies in moderate-to-severe ulcerative colitis

source.title: Benefit-risk profiling of advanced therapies in moderate-to-severe ulcerative colitis: a clustered network meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: Based on current network estimates, Upadacitinib is suggested among the most efficacious options for achieving clinical and endoscopic endpoints, particularly in refractory disease, while IL-23 antagonists present highly favorable tolerability profiles for maintenance without compromising efficacy.

source.title: Before Sepsis Strikes: Artificial Intelligence for Early Prediction of Postoperative Sepsis and Sepsis-Related Complications After Major Abdominal Surgery-A Systematic Review.
source.excerpt: Although several AI/ML models showed promising predictive performance, the available evidence remains insufficient to support routine use of AI/ML prediction models across major abdominal surgical populations.

cards.headline: Next-Generation Biomarkers and Artificial Intelligence in Colorectal Cancer

source.title: Next-Generation Biomarkers and Artificial Intelligence in Colorectal Cancer: From Multi-Omic Data Integration to Clinical Application.
source.excerpt: Priorities for the coming years are prospective validation of AI-guided treatment algorithms, integration of spatial transcriptomics and single-cell approaches, federated learning to support multi-institutional collaboration without compromising privacy, and standardised protocols for biomarker testing and interpretation.

cards.headline: Möchte einer von euch gern, daß er einen Garten habe mit Palmen und Rebstöcken …

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:266
source.excerpt: أيرغب الواحد منكم أن يكون له بستان فيه النخيل والأعناب، تجري من تحت أشجارِه المياه العذبة، وله فيه من كل ألوان الثمرات، وقد بلغ الكِبَر، ولا يستطيع أن يغرس مثل هذا الغرس، وله أولاد صغار في حاجة إلى هذا البستان وفي هذه الحالة هبَّت عليه ريح شديدة، فيها نار محرقة فأحرقته; وهكذا حال غير المخلصين في نفقاتهم، يأتون يوم القيامة ولا حسنة لهم.

cards.arabic: أَيَوَدُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَن تَكُونَ لَهُۥ جَنَّةٌ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَابٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ لَهُۥ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ وَأَصَابَهُ ٱلْكِبَرُ وَلَهُۥ ذُرِّيَّةٌ ضُعَفَآءُ فَأَصَابَهَآ إِعْصَارٌ فِيهِ نَارٌ فَٱحْتَرَقَتْ ۗ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَفَكَّرُونَ
cards.translation: Möchte einer von euch gern, daß er einen Garten habe mit Palmen und Rebstöcken, durcheilt von Bächen, in dem er von allen Früchten hat, während ihn (schon) hohes Alter getroffen hat und er (noch) schwache Nachkommenschaft hat, und daß ihn (den Garten) dann ein glühend heißer Wirbelwind treffe und er hierauf verbrenne? So macht Allah euch die Zeichen klar, auf daß ihr nachdenken möget!
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?

cards.headline: O die ihr glaubt, gebt aus von den guten Dingen aus eurem Erworbenen und von dem …

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:267
source.excerpt: يا من آمنتم بي واتبعتم رسلي أنفقوا من الحلال الطيب الذي كسبتموه ومما أخرجنا لكم من الأرض، ولا تقصدوا الرديء منه لتعطوه الفقراء، ولو أُعطِيتموه لم تأخذوه إلا إذا تغاضيتم عما فيه من رداءة ونقص. فكيف ترضون لله ما لا ترضونه لأنفسكم؟ واعلموا أن الله الذي رزقكم غني عن صدقاتكم، مستحق للثناء، محمود في كل حال.

cards.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَنفِقُوا۟ مِن طَيِّبَـٰتِ مَا كَسَبْتُمْ وَمِمَّآ أَخْرَجْنَا لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَلَا تَيَمَّمُوا۟ ٱلْخَبِيثَ مِنْهُ تُنفِقُونَ وَلَسْتُم بِـَٔاخِذِيهِ إِلَّآ أَن تُغْمِضُوا۟ فِيهِ ۚ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌ
cards.translation: O die ihr glaubt, gebt aus von den guten Dingen aus eurem Erworbenen und von dem, was Wir für euch aus der Erde hervorgebracht haben. Und sucht nicht zum Ausgeben das Schlechte davon aus, während ihr (selbst) es nicht nehmen würdet, ohne dabei ein Auge zuzudrücken. Und wißt, daß Allah Unbedürftig und Lobenswürdig ist.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: The Encouragement to Spend Honest Money for Allah's Sake: Allah commands His believing servants to spend in charity, as Ibn `Abbas stated, from the pure, honest money that they earned and from the fruits and vegetables that He has grown for them in the land.
